text:
Nikhil (Product): quick follow-up from the all-hands pricing segment 1: can we confirm rollover and rate-limit behavior so docs/console copy align?
Sam (Finance): TL;DR: trial credits do NOT roll over. paid accounts auto-roll up to 25% of monthly credits for one month; rolled credits expire after 30 days. enterprise SOWs can override.
Nikhil (Product): automatic for paid customers? opt-in?
Sam (Finance): automatic. opt-in only for bespoke enterprise credit packages (SOW).
Maya (Eng): enforcement question: when monthly + rollover exhausted, do we throttle or immediately 429?
Iris (Support): plan is soft-throttle via a burst buffer for short spikes; once buffer drained we return 429 with retry info. docs should include example payload and suggested retry semantics.
Maya (Eng): sample 429 for SDKs/console:
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "quota_exceeded",
  "detail": "Monthly credits exhausted; burst buffer applied. Next available tokens in 45s.",
  "retry_after": 45
}
Nikhil (Product): console copy suggestion: "You've used your monthly credits. Rolled-over credits expire in 30 days. Retry in 45s or upgrade to Dedicated."
Ava (CEO): customer-facing messaging must be short and consistent across touchpoints. Put this line in marketing FAQ.
Sam (Finance): roadmap: Q3 add per-product buckets (generation, embeddings, rerank) with defaults; customers can request custom splits via support; enterprise can specify in SOW.
quota-bot: Reminder set  update /docs/credits-rollover by 2026-04-20. Assigned: @Nikhil.
Iris (Support): I'll draft a short support FAQ and canned responses.
Maya (Eng): engineering note: implement burst buffer as token-bucket with 2x burst and 30s decay window; PR planned next week.
Sam (Finance): if customers frequently rely on burst, surface a suggestion to move to Dedicated/reserved capacity.
Nikhil (Product): I'll prepare a one-pager and diagram for the all-hands recap email.
Ava (CEO): thanks everyone, flag SLA tradeoffs immediately. :thumbsup:
